name: Echoes of Past Lives
source:
Echoes of Past Lives is a visual novel about a girl whose life does not end with death. Every time everything starts from the beginning. All the pain experienced by the main character echoes through all previous lives, making existence unbearable and senseless. After endless attempts, there is hope, maybe it is you.

[Translated from [url=https://prltrn.itch.io/echoes-of-past-lives]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Echoes of Past Lives》是一部讲述生命不会随死亡终结的少女的视觉小说。每一次死去，一切都会从头再来。主角所经历的一切痛苦在无数前世之间不断回响，令存在本身变得难以忍受而又毫无意义。在永无止境的轮回尝试之后，一丝希望终于浮现——或许那个人正是你。

[译自[url=https://prltrn.itch.io/echoes-of-past-lives]itch.io[/url]]
